news.text: 🆙❗️"Before communicating the need to go into a training retreat, #Carnevali spoke directly to the players. The goal was to clear the air, confront the issues and explain that everyone is being monitored, moving beyond just tactical work and the coach's duties. Against #Napoli, the club saw a cohesive team with a single line of thought: this was exactly what had been missing. It is a first strong signal of the determination to emerge from this difficult moment."[Giovanni Albanese - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

👀⚠️ "#KoloMuani could end up on the bench, with #Woltemade starting both on Thursday and Sunday, developing a tactical solution with an additional attacking winger. At this moment, the Frenchman is unable to play even as a winger."[Alfredo Pedullà - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🇺🇸❓#McKennie could miss the match against #AZ, but a call-up is still not ruled out: he could travel with the team to support the group, potentially representing an emergency option from the bench. The final decision will be made tomorrow, with #Spalletti and the staff assessing his condition and prioritizing caution to avoid any relapses.[Sky Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

🇩🇿👀 #Juventus is once again tracking #AitNouri: he is finding little playing time and could request a transfer in January. He had already been courted by the bianconeri in the summer and would be open to a change of shirt. Purchased by #ManchesterCity for €37M and under contract until 2030, he could represent an opportunity through a loan with an obligation to buy.[L'Équipe via @juventusinsidernews]

#Juve Relaunch: Another 250 MillionCapital increase#Carnevali: "A strong and ambitious club. #Spalletti is our manager and we support him".[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

120 MILLION FOR THE MERCATO#Juve, the 250 million capital increase and the ambitions. Half of the euros still shelled out by #Elkann will be aimed at maintaining sporting competitiveness: from scouting to signings, passing by infrastructure. Confidence and applause for #Carnevali: "Now we are laying the foundations to return to winning ways".[Front Page TuttoSport]

▶️ Shareholders Meeting🗣 Stefano #Cerrato responds to Shareholders Carones and Gambacorti: "The outlook for the €250M is linked to sporting performance: 45/50% of the resources will be used to maintain an adequate net equity. The remaining portion will be allocated to maintaining sporting competitiveness and controlling debt".[@juventusinsidernews]

▶️ Shareholders Meeting🗣 Speech by shareholder Paolo Carones: "Shareholder Cozzolino had predicted that the €100M would be insufficient and that, a year later, we would be back here discussing it. What is the estimate for the use of the €250M in January, net of the financial constraints imposed by the FFP?".🗣 Gambacorti also adds: "The hope is that the €250M does not become an ATM for Serie A".[@juventusinsidernews]

▶️ Shareholders Meeting ✅ Green light for #Juventus's capital increase: the maneuver up to €250M has been approved with 99.9% of the votes in favor. EXOR guarantees total coverage and immediately pays an advance of €60M: from 2007 to today, the resources injected by the ownership total nearly €1.5B.[@juventusinsidernews]

▶️ Shareholders Meeting✅🗣 Giovanni #Carnevali: "It is possible to supplement the squad list for the Europa League. #Locatelli can be replaced by a player who is already part of the squad, provided he was formed in Italy. We will do this with #Ekhator".[@juventusinsidernews]
▶️ Shareholders Meeting - Approved the authorization for the purchase and disposal of treasury shares, with 91.6% of votes in favor.[@juventusinsidernews]

▶️ Shareholders Meeting- Approved the appointment of two directors to supplement the Board of Directors following the cessation of office of two directors, with 91.8% of votes in favor;- Approved the compensation plan based on financial instruments, with 91.6% of votes in favor;- Approved the report on the remuneration policy and compensation paid, with 91.53% of votes in favor.[@juventusinsidernews]

▶️ Shareholders Meeting🗣 Giovanni #Carnevali: "I was contacted by the Shareholder and I will give my absolute best for this club. Otherwise, I would have stayed where I was for 13 years, at #Sassuolo. I chose to come to #Juventus because I consider this experience a challenge. When I first arrived at #Sassuolo there were only four employees. Here the context is different, it is a source of pride to be at #Juventus. There is a lot of work to be done, I know I have to work hard and I know that it won't be easy. I don't want to say that we will win tomorrow, but that we will work toward doing so, it won't be easy. To build something important, it takes time and hard work, not empty talk".[@juve

▶️ Shareholders Meeting🗣 Giovanni #Carnevali: "I am pleased to be here, it is my first time and I like it. I believe this is a moment to understand and learn from all of you, knowing what it is you want. I welcome all the observations that have been addressed to me and I accept them. I rely on capable collaborators, like #Massara and #Ottolini, but #Chiellini also plays a fundamental role. I do not know if we will be able to achieve certain results and I do not want to sell smoke, but we will work hard to achieve them. ▶️ Shareholders Meeting🗣 Shareholder Graziano Spinelli: "I echo Danubi's words. I would like to know what initiatives you intend to undertake following the dismissal ruling regarding the capital gains case. I also want to complement #Carnevali for clarifying precisely what #Juventus's work will look like on the youth front".[@juventusinsidernews]

▶️ Shareholders Meeting🗣 Shareholder Andrea Danubi: "I would like to say a few words about the Mazzola incident. The Curva was unfairly criticized. I respect those who respect me, but the ex #Inter captain did not show the same regard towards us. Death does not erase the actions and words spoken during one's lifetime, but no one should presume to lecture us on morality. The guys in the Curva did the right thing by not giving in to political correctness".[@juventusinsidernews]

▶️ Shareholders Meeting🗣 The counter-replies from the Shareholders are arriving, starting with Campagnola: "I advise you to engage with the second largest shareholder: Tether deserves attention and a deeper look".[@juventusinsidernews]
